about_the_game:
Enter the world of Refrogger – a parallel dimension of Arma Reforger content, stunning wallpapers, ASMR(ma) loops, and heartfelt thank yous from the devs.

The Refrogger Supporter Pack is for those who want to show their support for the game and the devs and get their hands on exclusive digital content not available elsewhere. This pack contains yet unseen in-game wallpapers, ridiculous frog propaganda, printable posters, ASMR(ma) loops, and more.

Support the development of the most realistic and immersive military simulator available and enrich your digital asset collection with a treasure trove of exclusive content!

How to Access Arma Reforger - Refrogger Supporter Pack Contents:

  • Open Steam and go to your Library.

  • Right-click on Arma Reforger in the game list.

  • Select Manage → Installed Files.

  • Click on Browse to open the game’s installation folder.

  • In the opened folder, look for RefroggerPack — this is the brainrot content you're looking for.

Now, with the Refrogger Supporter Pack, you can show your support for the game and its developers, and in return receive a treasure trove of exclusive digital assets.
